authentication.provides: authenticity and non-repudiation of the envelope; NOT confidentiality — see the encryption block
authentication.request_body: {"jws": "<compact JWS whose payload claim is a sealed body>", "trust": {<five scored dimensions>}}
authentication.key: sender's registered identity key; the SPKI fingerprint must match the one pinned in a2a_agents

encryption.note: A signed plaintext body is refused. The payload claim must be a sealed body of the shape below.
encryption.key_agreement: ECDH P-256, ephemeral sender key to the recipient key below. Ephemeral for forward secrecy: a later compromise of the recipient key does not open a transcript captured before it.
encryption.kdf: HKDF-SHA256, 32-byte random per-message salt, info "a2a-seal-1 content-key aes-256-gcm", 32-byte output. The raw ECDH output is never used as a key.
encryption.cipher: AES-256-GCM, 12-byte random nonce per message, full 16-byte tag (a shorter tag is refused)
encryption.aad: JSON array ["a2a-seal-1", iss, aud, jti] — the ciphertext is bound to this envelope and does not open in another
encryption.plaintext: UTF-8 JSON of the application object

sealed_body.epk: base64url SPKI DER of the sender's ephemeral P-256 public key

encryption.recipient_public_key_pem: served at runtime from this deployment's identity key; not checked into the repository
encryption.recipient_key_fingerprint: served at runtime; compare it against the key pinned for this agent in your own registry rather than trusting this response
encryption.provides: confidentiality of the body against anyone on the path between the two agents, and integrity of the ciphertext. It does not protect the body from the receiving agent, which necessarily opens it.

trust_policy.note: Each dimension must carry a score and a written justification. A score without a reason is refused.

privacy.purpose: Evaluate a candidate for a selected job opening
privacy.audit: Every decision is logged with a SHA-256 of the sealed body. The audit trail never holds the body, sealed or opened.
